convert_maskformer_checkpoint: convert a MaskFormer ResNet checkpoint from Facebook's pickle format to a PyTorch model
get_maskformer_config: get a MaskFormer configuration for a given model name and dataset with correct label mappings
create_rename_keys: create a list of source-to-target key rename mappings for converting checkpoint weights
read_in_decoder_q_k_v: split transformer decoder input projection matrices into separate query, key, and value projections
run_convert_script: run the convert_maskformer_resnet_to_pytorch CLI script with model name and checkpoint path arguments
